fields.name: trip_id_performed
fields.title: ID referencing trips_performed.trip_id_performed
fields.description: Identifies the trip performed during this crew assignment. Optional so that a single assignment can span consecutive trips (interlining) or cover vehicle time not tied to one trip; populate it wherever a single trip applies, which keeps joins with trips_performed simple.

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicles.vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle the crew member is assigned to. Must match trips_performed.vehicle_id for the same performed trip when trip_id_performed is populated.

fields.name: crew_id
fields.title: ID referencing crew.crew_id
fields.description: Identifies the crew member. References the crew table.

fields.name: crew_role
fields.description: Role of the crew member on the vehicle.

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Timestamp when the crew member's assignment began.

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: Timestamp when the crew member's assignment ended. Null if assignment is ongoing.

name: vehicle_crew.schema.json
description: Crew member assignments to vehicles and trips, supporting multiple crew members and mid-trip reliefs.
